page.layout: Single image: the outside of a book binding, not a printed page. Leather boards with a blind-tooled frame of scalloped and dotted lines around a central panel. No printed text in any block.
page.notes: This scan shows the front cover of a bound volume, not a text page. The leather is dark brown and red, worn and stained, with a blind-tooled border of scallops and dots and an inner rectangular panel. There is a pale patch of damage on the upper right edge and a dark stain or label-like mark at the lower left. No title, lettering, or printed words are visible, so there is nothing to transcribe. Any printed text would be on the title page or first leaf, which is not in this scan.
